Settings.title: Settings
Settings.lead: How matches reach you, when they arrive, and whose credits pay for your application kits.
Settings.footnote: A match goes out once on every channel that is on. Nothing else is ever sent from here.

anonymous.title: Delivery needs an account
anonymous.body: This session disappears with your CV after 24 hours, so there is nowhere to send anything yet. Create an account and Pemby can reach you on Telegram, by email, or on this browser.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.help: Each match as a message you can act on without opening a browser.
telegram.linkLead: Open this link on the device your Telegram is on. It works once, and asking for another one replaces it.

email.label: Email
email.help: One email per match, to the address this account signed in with.

push.label: Push
push.help: A notification on this browser, even when Pemby is closed.
push.homeScreen: On iPhone and iPad, push works only for a web app saved to the Home Screen. Open the share menu, choose Add to Home Screen, open Pemby from there, and turn this on.
push.unsupported: This browser has no push service. Telegram and email still work.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then reload this page.
push.unavailable: Push is not configured in this environment.
push.installed: Pemby is running as an installed app here, so push will work.
push.elsewhere: {count, plural, one {# other browser is subscribed.} other {# other browsers are subscribed.}}

quiet.label: Quiet hours
quiet.help: Nothing is sent inside this window. Anything that would have arrived waits and comes after it ends.
quiet.needsChannel: Turn on a channel first. Quiet hours are stored with your channels, so there is nowhere to keep them yet.
quiet.wraps: This window runs overnight and ends at {until} the next morning.

pause.title: Hold everything
pause.body: Nothing goes out on any channel while delivery is held. Matches keep being made; they wait for you.
pause.heldBody: Held {since}. Nothing has gone out on any channel since then.
pause.heldBodyJustNow: Held just now. Nothing will go out on any channel until you start it again.

dead.blocked: Telegram reports the bot is blocked. Unblock it in Telegram, then connect again.
dead.chat-not-found: That Telegram chat no longer exists. Connect again to pick a new one.
dead.push-expired: The push service dropped this subscription. Turn push on again in the browser you want it on.
dead.address-invalid: Mail to this address was refused for good. Switching email back on tries it again.
dead.permanent-failure: This channel stopped working and nothing is being sent on it. Set it up again.

errors.unauthenticated: You've been signed out. Sign in and try again.
errors.forbidden: This account can't change delivery settings.
errors.invalid_patch: That setting didn't look right, so nothing was changed.
errors.invalid_subscription: This browser's subscription wasn't accepted. Turn push off and on again.
errors.subscription_taken: This browser's notifications still belong to another account. Turn push off and on again to claim them.
errors.telegram_unavailable: Telegram isn't set up in this environment yet.
errors.network: No connection, so nothing was changed.
errors.push_refused: This browser didn't allow notifications, so nothing was changed.

Settings.aiFootnote: Pemby pays for three application kits a month. Connect your OpenRouter account and your kits are paid from your own credits instead, with no monthly limit. Pemby stores the key encrypted and uses it only for your kits.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.help: Pemby pays for your kits: three a month. Connecting your own account lifts that limit.
openrouter.helpConnected: Your kits are paid from your OpenRouter credits. If your key can't pay, Pemby says so and stops — it never falls back to its own key.
openrouter.checkedOk: OpenRouter answered for this key: it works.
openrouter.justConnected: Connected. Your kits are paid from your own credits from now on.
openrouter.manageLead: Pemby holds this key to pay for your kits. Pemby cannot revoke it — only you can, on your own OpenRouter account.
openrouter.revokeLead: Pemby has deleted its copy of your key. The key itself is still live on your OpenRouter account, and Pemby cannot revoke it — remove it there yourself.
openrouter.revokeNote: This link is built from the key's fingerprint, which Pemby no longer stores. Close this panel and the link is gone; the key is still listed on your OpenRouter keys page.
openrouter.strandedKey: If OpenRouter made a key before this failed, Pemby did not keep it. Remove it yourself:

openrouterErrors.unauthenticated: You've been signed out. Sign in and try again.
openrouterErrors.forbidden: This account can't connect an OpenRouter key.
openrouterErrors.secret_unavailable: Connecting an OpenRouter account isn't configured in this environment yet.
openrouterErrors.not_connected: There's no OpenRouter key on this account.
openrouterErrors.key_undecryptable: Pemby can't read the stored key any more. Disconnect, then connect again.
openrouterErrors.key_rejected: OpenRouter no longer recognises this key — it was removed there. Connect again to make a new one.
openrouterErrors.credits_exhausted: Your OpenRouter account is out of credits. Top it up, then check again.
openrouterErrors.key_limit_reached: This key has reached its own spending limit. Raise the limit at OpenRouter, or connect again to make a new key.
openrouterErrors.in_flight_retry: OpenRouter is holding requests on this key for a moment. Check again shortly.
openrouterErrors.no_code: OpenRouter sent you back without an approval, so nothing was connected.
openrouterErrors.start_expired: That took longer than ten minutes, so the approval had expired. Start again.
openrouterErrors.state_mismatch: That approval didn't match the one this browser started, so nothing was connected. Start again.
openrouterErrors.code_rejected: OpenRouter refused the approval — it had expired, or it had already been used. Start again.
openrouterErrors.exchange_failed: OpenRouter didn't return a key, so nothing was connected.
openrouterErrors.network: No connection, so nothing was changed.
